data.text:
We’re close to announcing our first official partnership with a physical establishment here in the Philippines 🇵🇭

Through this collaboration, you’ll be able to get exclusive @sillykittiesco merch designed specifically for this partner, limited, unique, and not available anywhere else.

This is bigger than just a drop.

The goal is to test, learn, and understand what truly works outside of Web3 in real world retail, with real customers, real foot traffic, and real purchasing behavior.

I’m intentionally building a network of physical establishments. Over time, this becomes more than partnerships. It becomes infrastructure.

Infrastructure that I can later use to

• Help Web3 brands break into offline retail
• Guide up and coming brands that do not know where to start
• Bridge digital communities into real world commerce

This is not an easy task. It takes a lot of effort, persistence, and real conviction. Not many people can do it because you have to convince physical establishments that your brand deserves placement in front of their customers.

Stay silly! 😻
